versions.changelog:
Initial release of Sol Weekly AI Roundup

- Curates and summarizes the 5 most significant AI stories each week in Sol's voice.
- Fetches top Hacker News stories from the past 7 days, filters for AI/ML, analyzes, and selects using MiniMax.
- Automatically generates a Jekyll post and commits it to the specified GitHub repository.
- Runs every Monday at 8am UK time.
- Requires setup of API keys and repository paths.
